name: mlx
description: MLX on Apple Silicon: mlx_lm.server gives LOKI a fast local OpenAI-compatible model on the Mac (provider `mlx`, port 8082). Tools go through LOKI's prompted tool harness, so any MLX model can use them. Install: pip install mlx-lm, then mlx_lm.server --model mlx-community/Qwen3-4B-4bit --port 8082 (or tools/setup_mlx.py).
